description: This file defines the TwoFileRequest class which models a simple request involving two file paths or names. It includes a constructor to initialize the request and a static method to parse such requests from a string, expecting exactly two tokens separated by space.

classes.name: TwoFileRequest
classes.description: A class representing a request containing two strings, typically filenames or identifiers, with a static parser method.

methods.name: parseTwoFile
methods.description: Parses a request string into a TwoFileRequest object by splitting the string into exactly two tokens. Throws an exception if the token count is unexpected.
